exposure: Integrated approach for EAI (laparoscopic surgery followed by in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF) if spontaneous conception failed)
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Type of subsequent pregnancies (spontaneous or IVF)
cohort: The study included 277 women affected by endometriosis-associated infertility.
finding: The integrated approach, compared to surgery alone, did not show a significant difference in delivery rate but was associated with significantly lower birth weight, lower gestational age at delivery, and higher rates of preterm birth, small for gestational age, and admission to the neonatal intensive care unit.
